script: セイバールート十五日目-03
title: セイバールート十五日目-03

pages.ja: それは、誰に責められる事でもない。
pages.jaRuby: それは、誰に責められる事でもない。
pages.en: No one could blame her for it.
pages.mirrorMoon: It is something no one could blame her for.

pages.ja:
「
、え？」
呆然と、彼女は足元に転がるモノを見た。
両指の感触がなく、自分が何を感じているかも定かではない。
認識できる現実は唯一つ。
彼女の主だった少年は、守ろうとした彼女自身の手で、その命を終えていた。
pages.jaRuby:
「
、え？」

両指の感触がなく、自分が何を感じているかも定かではない。
認識できる現実は唯一つ。
彼女の主だった少年は、守ろうとした彼女自身の手で、その命を終えていた。
pages.en:
“What…?”

Dazed, she stares at the thing lying at her feet.

There is no feeling in her fingers. She cannot even be certain what she herself is feeling.

Only one reality remains within her comprehension.

The boy who had been her Master has met his end by the hand of the very woman who tried to protect him.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Eh?”
She looks with blank amazement at the thing at her feet.
Her fingers are numb, and she cannot tell what she is feeling.
There is only one truth she can recognize.
Her master’s life has been ended by his own protector’s action.

pages.ja:
「
シロウ？」
思っただけ。
ほんの一瞬、聖杯を求めただけ。
その願いはすぐに消え、彼女は何より少年の命を優先させた。
それでも、魔が入り込む隙があった。
一度思うだけで十分だった。
長く、長く疲労し磨り減っていた彼女の心は、爪の先ほどの弱さに負けてしまった。

pages.en:
“Shirou?”

It was only a thought.

For a single instant, she desired the Holy Grail.

The wish vanished at once, and she placed the boy's life above all else.

Even so, evil found an opening.

One thought was enough.

Her heart, worn away by long, unending exhaustion, succumbed to a weakness no larger than the tip of a fingernail.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Shirou?”
She only considered it.
She wished for the Holy Grail only for an instant.
That wish disappeared in an instant, and she valued the boy’s life.
But there was still enough time for her to be driven by evil.
Thinking about it once was enough.
Her strained mind crumbled with that small weakness.

pages.ja:
「違う
うそだ、シロウ」
息絶えた主に手を伸ばす。
その亡骸を抱き上げる少女に、かつての気高さは何処にもない。
pages.jaRuby:

うそだ、シロウ」

pages.en:
“No—this is a lie, Shirou.”

She reaches toward her lifeless Master.

Nothing of her former nobility remains in the girl as she gathers his body into her arms.

pages.ja:
「
よくやったセイバー。その慟哭、聖杯を受け取るに相応しい」
暗闇に声が響く。
彼岸からの招きに応じるように、自失したまま、彼女は聖杯を受け入れた。
pages.jaRuby:
「
よくやったセイバー。その慟哭、聖杯を受け取るに相応しい」
暗闇に声が響く。
彼岸からの招きに応じるように、自失したまま、彼女は聖杯を受け入れた。
pages.en:
“Well done, Saber. That lament befits one who would receive the Holy Grail.”

A voice resounds in the darkness.

As though answering a summons from the far shore, the girl accepts the Holy Grail, still lost to herself.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Well done, Saber. That lamentation… it is indeed appropriate to receive the Holy Grail.”
A voice echoes through the darkness.
As if answering his call, she accepts the Holy Grail in a daze.
